## Control de versiones

Nunca agregar líneas de "Co-Authored-By: Claude" o "Generated with Claude Code" en los mensajes de commit. Los commits deben verse como trabajo normal del desarrollador, sin mención de herramientas de IA.

*Source: https://www.ufcgym.mx/ — generated by /taste*

### Tokens

**Colors**
- Background: `#000000`
- Surface-alt (below-fold sections): `#FFFFFF`
- Text primary: `#FFFFFF`
- Text muted: `#ABABAB`
- Accent — persistent action (CTA only): `#CD122C`
- Accent — campaign-only (limited-time banners only): `#E30202`

**Typography**
- Display/headline: custom brush-marker face (real name unrecoverable, site serves it as a hashed Wix font) — used at 55.7px–144.7px, always weight 400
- Functional/body: Helvetica Neue, Arial fallback — used at 15.6px–33.4px, always weight 400
- No font-weight variation anywhere in the sample (100% weight "400" across 3 pages) — hierarchy comes from typeface + size only

**Spacing**

- No consistent base unit — arbitrary, per-section sizing, not a systematic grid

**Radius**

**Shadows**
- `rgba(0,0,0,0.6) -0.63px 0.78px 4px 0px` (photo cards) — single layer, pure black
- `rgba(0,0,0,0.1) 1px 2px 8px 1px` (home page elements) — single layer, pure black

**Image ratios**
- Hero: 1.74:1 (landscape)
- Content/location cards: 0.50:1 (portrait)
- Icons/logos: 1:1

### Directives

- When a CTA needs to stand out on an otherwise monochrome surface, confine the accent color to that single element (button fill, one divider stroke) — a viewer should have exactly one warm thing to find, not several.
- When establishing headline hierarchy, use a dedicated display typeface plus a size jump instead of increasing font-weight — weight stays flat at 400 everywhere; the typeface itself signals "this is a headline."
- When placing photography on a dark/black surface, use a single hard-edged, pure-black shadow instead of soft multi-layer elevation — a hard cutout reads as a physical object placed on the surface, not a floating software card.
- When spacing sections on an editorial/narrative page, size gaps per-section based on content weight rather than snapping to a fixed grid — editorial breathing room beats mechanical consistency on storytelling pages.
- Reserve two distinct accent hues for two distinct jobs if the product needs it: one muted hue for persistent/always-available actions, one brighter hue for time-limited/campaign moments — never let the two swap roles.

### Anti-patterns

- Never spread the accent color into headers, borders, or icon fills — confine it to primary CTAs only.
- Never rely on font-weight (bold/semibold) to create headline hierarchy — use typeface and size instead.
- Never use soft, multi-layer, or hue-tinted shadows on photography over a dark background — use a single hard, pure-black shadow.
- Avoid forcing a strict mathematical spacing scale on purely editorial/narrative sections — arbitrary, content-driven gaps are acceptable there. (Operational/data-dense UI is the opposite case — see project-specific overrides when this taste is adapted for a dashboard or form context.)
